title.zh: ECB launches Pontes to settle tokenized assets without stablecoins
title.en: ECB launches Pontes to settle tokenized assets without stablecoins

current_state.zh: ECB已宣布推出Pontes平台，并计划用自有资金购买代币化债券，结算将通过Pontes以央行货币进行，全面实施预计在2028年。
current_state.en: The ECB has announced the Pontes platform and plans to buy tokenized bonds with its own funds, with settlement through Pontes in central bank money and full implementation expected by 2028.

updates.title_zh: ECB plans to buy tokenized bonds with its own funds
updates.title_en: ECB plans to buy tokenized bonds with its own funds
updates.what_changed_zh: ECB宣布计划动用一小部分自有储备投资欧元计价的代币化证券，并通过新平台Pontes以央行货币结算；具体规模和时机将在准备工作完成后决定，Pontes预计2028年全面实施。
updates.what_changed_en: The ECB announced it plans to invest a small portion of its reserves in euro-denominated tokenized securities, settled in central bank money through the new Pontes platform; size and timing will be decided after preparatory work, with full Pontes implementation expected by 2028.
updates.current_state_zh: ECB已宣布推出Pontes平台，并计划用自有资金购买代币化债券，结算将通过Pontes以央行货币进行，全面实施预计在2028年。
